name: model-router
description: Haiku sorts every subagent task into simple, standard, hard or long run and picks the model; a pane shows what each agent cost.

baseline.title: Compare against
baseline.description: What the bill pane prices the same tokens on, to show what routing saved. unrouted: the model each agent would have run on without the router (its parent's), so the main conversation saves nothing

routeAll.title: Route every subagent
routeAll.description: On: route built-in subagents (Explore, general-purpose) too. Off: only the four router agents.

respectExplicitModel.title: Keep a model Claude asked for
respectExplicitModel.description: On: when the Agent call already names a model, leave it alone
